title: Content and Digital Engagement Officer
company: St Nicholas Hospice Care - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you a creative storyteller with a passion for digital engagement and creating content that makes a difference?

At St Nicholas Hospice Care, we're looking for a Content and Digital Engagement Officer to help us tell our stories, connect with our community and bring the work of the Hospice to life across our digital channels.

Working as part of our Marketing and Communications team, you'll lead the day-to-day delivery of our organic social media activity and create engaging photography, video, written and visual content. You'll develop content plans, identify opportunities for great stories and support campaigns across fundraising, volunteering, recruitment, retail and awareness of our services.

This is a varied, creative role where you'll work with colleagues, volunteers, supporters, patients and families to capture stories and develop content that encourages people to engage with and support the Hospice. Given the nature of our work, you'll also need the sensitivity and judgement to communicate stories relating to dying, death, grief and serious illness with empathy and care.

We're looking for someone who has:
- Experience creating content for social media and digital channels
- Experience managing organisational social media accounts
- Strong photography and video-production skills
- Excellent written, visual and verbal communication skills
- Experience planning and scheduling content
- Confidence using content creation and design software such as Canva and Adobe Creative Suite
- Creativity, initiative and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Why join us?

Every role at St Nicholas Hospice Care contributes to supporting people facing dying, death and grief. In return, you'll join a welcoming, values-led organisation where you'll play an important role in supporting our people and strengthening our workplace culture.

If you're passionate about digital storytelling and want to use your creativity to make a meaningful difference in your local community, we'd love to hear from you.

Working for us:

As an employee you will receive the following benefits:

Health Cash Plan & Wellbeing programme

25 days annual leave increasing to 29 with service (pro rata for part time employees)

Enhanced Occupational sick pay scheme

Access to a group pension plan or continuation of NHS Pension (subject to criteria)

Life assurance

Access to Blue Light Card scheme

Social events (such as photography group, quiz nights, picnics and more)

title: E-Commerce Coordinator
description:
E-Commerce Coordinator

Location: Ipswich
Salary: £35,000 per annum
Contract: Permanent
Shift Pattern: 4 on / 4 off, 12-hour shifts

About the Role
We're looking for a proactive and hands-on E-Commerce Coordinator to support the day-to-day running of a fast-paced online retail operation in Ipswich.

This is a varied role that combines team coordination, warehouse operations, order fulfilment and problem-solving. You'll play a key part in ensuring customer orders are processed accurately, stock is managed effectively and daily operations run smoothly.

This isn't a desk-based position. We're looking for someone who enjoys being involved in the operation, supporting their team, leading by example and taking ownership of challenges as they arise.

The successful candidate will be confident organising workloads, motivating colleagues and maintaining high standards across both warehouse and online sales activities.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate the daily running of fulfilment and online sales operations
- Organise and allocate workloads across the team to ensure maximum efficiency
- Support and motivate team members throughout each shift
- Oversee the picking, packing and dispatch of customer orders
- Ensure courier collections are organised and shipments leave on time
- Monitor operational performance and resolve issues quickly and effectively
- Maintain accurate stock records and support inventory management processes
- Use internal systems to manage orders, stock movements and reporting
- Assist with onboarding and training new team members
- Work closely with management and operational teams to improve processes and maintain service levels
- Occasionally provide support during live online sales events when required

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within warehouse, fulfilment, logistics or e-commerce operations
- Experience leading, coordinating or supervising a team
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise effectively
- A proactive and solutions-focused mindset
- Confident decision-maker who can work well under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Good IT skills with experience using warehouse, stock or order management systems
- A hands-on approach and willingness to support the wider team when needed

Ideal Backgrounds We would be particularly interested in candidates with experience as:
- Warehouse Team Leader
- Fulfilment Supervisor
- Logistics Coordinator
- Dispatch Supervisor
- Operations Coordinator
- E-Commerce Supervisor
- Warehouse Shift Manager
- Goods-In or Goods-Out Team Leader

Why Join?
- Permanent position offering long-term stability
- Competitive salary of £35,000 per annum
- 4 on / 4 off shift pattern providing excellent work-life balance
- Growing and fast-moving business environment
- Supportive management team and opportunities for progression

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced operations professional who enjoys leading from the front, driving efficiency and building a positive team culture within a growing e-commerce environment.

Please apply with an up to date CV or contact Keeley for more information - (phone number removed)

title: Ecommerce Warehouse Operative
description:
Ecommerce Warehouse Operative
Location: Ipswich
Salary: £35,000 per annum
Contract: Permanent
Shift Pattern: 4 on / 4 off, 12-hour shifts

About the Role
We're looking for an experienced and hands-on Ecommerce Warehouse Operative to join a fast-growing e-commerce operation in Ipswich.

This is a warehouse-first role where you'll be responsible for coordinating workloads, overseeing fulfilment operations and ensuring customer orders leave accurately and on time.

Working within a fast-paced warehouse environment, you'll be comfortable leading from the front, supporting staff, solving problems and maintaining high standards across the operation.

Alongside the warehouse and fulfilment responsibilities, you'll occasionally be required to step in and support online sales. Therefore, we're looking for someone with confidence, personality and strong communication skills.

This role would suit an experienced warehouse professional who enjoys taking responsibility, motivating a team and getting stuck into the day-to-day operation.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate warehouse and fulfillment operations
- Organise daily workloads and ensure tasks are completed efficiently
- Oversee the picking, packing and dispatch of customer orders
- Ensure courier collections are booked and shipments leave on time
- Monitor stock levels and maintain accurate inventory records
- Resolve operational issues and identify process improvements
- Support the onboarding and training of new team members
- Drive productivity and maintain high standards across the warehouse
- Use warehouse and order management systems to track activity and performance
- Liaise with management to ensure smooth day-to-day operations
- Step into online sales when required to support the wider team

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within a warehouse, fulfilment or logistics environment
- Experience leading, supervising or coordinating a team
- Confident working within a fast-paced operational environment
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage with others
- Comfortable speaking in front of customers
- Good IT skills and experience using warehouse or stock management systems
- A hands-on attitude with a willingness to support wherever needed
- Flexible and reliable approach to work

What's On Offer?
- £35,000 per annum
- Permanent opportunity
- 4 on / 4 off shift pattern
- Long-term career prospects within a growing business
- Fast-paced and varied working environment
- Opportunity to play a key role in a rapidly expanding operation

This is not a traditional office-based e-commerce role. We're looking for a warehouse professional with leadership ability, strong operational knowledge and the confidence to represent the business when needed.
